best_for: Anyone drawing logos, icons, diagrams or illustrations who wants an open, SVG-first editor on Windows, macOS or Linux.
description:
Inkscape is a vector drawing program made by an international community of volunteers. It saves to SVG, and you can watch and edit the drawing's code live in its XML editor.

Draw freehand, use the pen tool's Bézier, Spiro and B-spline modes, or letter with the calligraphy tool. Live path effects change a shape without destroying it: round its corners, bend it along a path, add perspective or a sketched look. You can trace a bitmap into color or black-and-white paths, set text on a path or inside a shape, and use variable fonts and right-to-left scripts. Outline and X-ray views help with busy drawings. Export to PNG, PDF, EPS, DXF and more, from the menus or the command line.

points.title: Vector, not photo
points.text: It is built for paths and shapes. Pixel-level photo retouching is outside its scope; use a raster editor for that and bring the results in as images.

points.title: What 1.4 added
points.text: Version 1.4 brought a Shape Builder that can also clip raster images, a Filter Gallery and an Extension Gallery, internal links in PDF export, and best-effort import of Affinity Designer files and the CGM format.

points.title: A bridge release for page files
points.text: The 1.4.x line can convert the page format planned for Inkscape 1.5 back to the current one. Versions older than 1.4.3 cannot read pages saved by 1.5 or later; opening and saving the file in 1.4.3 or newer converts it.

points.title: macOS: extensions and the command line
points.text: On the official macOS .dmg, extensions stop working if Inkscape was started from the command line. This is a deliberate security measure added in 1.4.3, and it also affects import and export formats that run through Python extensions.

points.title: Linux: a Wayland caveat
points.text: Depending on your Gtk version, Wayland sessions can crash when a docked tab is moved or a floating dialog is closed, and undocking can pick the wrong dialog. The 1.4.4 notes list this as a known issue.

points.title: Windows installers
points.text: Windows gets both an MSI and an .exe installer, and since 1.4.4 installation files for Windows on Arm. The Microsoft Store build is updated later than the direct download, potentially by a month.

points.title: Maintenance focus in 1.4.4
points.text: The current release is mainly fixes: about 20 crash fixes (three of them for cases where it would not start at all), other bug fixes, and performance changes.
